Change-Id: I56c24ac1ea0ac1b7f3101f267ba201b6d0904009

Tested-by: Platform Bot <platform-bot@eclipse.org>
Reviewed-by: Sebastian Ratz <sebastian.ratz@sap.com>
Reviewed-by: Matthias Becker <ma.becker@sap.com>
summary: This commit introduces a new Java class, refactors an inner class to a top-level one, and makes significant structural changes by adding new fields and methods to existing classes. While there's a localized change of adding `action.setActionDefinitionId(...)` before `action.setText(...)`, this requires matching a sequence of two statements and inserting a third statement between them. The TriggerPattern DSL primarily supports expression or single statement replacements, method annotation additions, or type widening, but not arbitrary insertion of statements within a sequence of existing statements. Therefore, this transformation is not safely expressible within the current DSL's capabilities.
